text: Incident INC-2291: a schema migration on the orders table waited for its ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock behind the nightly reporting job, which holds a read transaction on orders for up to 40 minutes from 01:00. Every checkout insert queued behind the migration, and checkout stalled for 11 minutes. Rehearse every migration on orders with the reporting job's long transaction running.

Incident INC-2304: autovacuum on the payments ledger table fell behind during the quarter-end batch, and payment lookups slowed down until the batch finished. Watch autovacuum on payments during quarter-end batches.
The warehouse pick-list dashboard depends on one query on the orders table, run every 30 seconds: the 50 oldest PAID orders still to pick, by created_at. It is a critical query for the warehouse.

metadata.name: warehouse pick list
metadata.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50

text: The checkout order-history page depends on one query on the orders table: a customer's 20 most recent orders, by created_at. It is a critical query for checkout.

metadata.name: customer order history
metadata.sql: SELECT id, status, amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 4242 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

text: The carrier hand-off screen depends on one query on the shipments table: shipments awaiting a carrier, oldest first. It is a critical query for the warehouse.

metadata.name: carrier hand-off
metadata.sql: SELECT id FROM shipments WHERE carrier_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100
